title: wbc-demo policy manifest
description: Human-authored metadata + artifact pointers for one policy in the wbc-demo gallery. Lives at policies/<id>/policy.yaml. Mirrors the PolicyManifest TypeScript interface in src/types.ts (issue wbc-mjlab-0d8). policy.yaml references the exporter's machine artifacts (policy.onnx, config.yaml, a clip set, a thumbnail) but never duplicates their contents.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Currently "1". Bumped on breaking manifest changes so the loader can migrate or reject incompatible files.

id.description: Optional in-file id. The FOLDER NAME is authoritative for the URL slug and registry id; if present here it is advisory and SHOULD match the folder name. URL-safe, lowercase kebab-case.

name.description: Display name shown on the gallery card and the policy page.

description.description: One-line summary for the gallery card.

robot.description: Robot/embodiment id, e.g. "g1". Matches the exporter's robot_id in config.yaml and robot in motion_library.yaml. Selects the robot GLB the viewer loads (issue wbc-mjlab-9as).

tags.description: Skill/grouping tags for gallery filtering. Known tags are suggested for consistency, but arbitrary tags are allowed.

author.description: Policy author / contributor name or handle.

links.description: External links surfaced on the policy page. All optional.

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail image path, relative to the policy folder (e.g. "thumb.png"). Shown on the gallery card.

defaultClip.description: Id of the clip to show first on the policy page. Must match a clip id in artifacts.clips (inline) or in the referenced motion library (manifest). The page falls back to the first available clip if omitted.

camera.description: Camera framing for the viewport: a named preset, or an explicit {pos,target} pose in world-space metres (Three.js axes, Y up).

oneOf.description: Explicit camera pose. pos -> camera.position; target -> orbit/look-at target.

artifacts.description: Pointers to the policy's machine artifacts. Paths are relative to the policy folder. Optional for an M1 metadata-only card; required for the M2 live engine.

onnx.description: ONNX policy network, e.g. "policy.onnx" (M2 live engine: onnxruntime-web).

config.description: Deploy obs/action config, e.g. "config.yaml" (schema_version: wbc_tracking_params_v1). Consumed by the M2 engine to wire the observation/action layout. Playback (M1) does not need it.

clips.description: Clip set for playback (issue wbc-mjlab-3ne). Pick ONE form: inline list with display metadata, OR a pointer to a motion_library.yaml manifest.

oneOf.description: Inline list of clips with display metadata. Best for a small, hand-curated showcase set.
Pointer to a motion_library.yaml manifest (schema: wbc_motion_library_v1) in the policy folder. Best for the exporter's bulk output; per-clip names/files are resolved from that file at load time.

file.description: Path to the motion-library manifest, relative to the policy folder.

default.description: Id of the clip to show first (must exist in the referenced library).

tag.description: A skill/grouping tag. Known tags are suggested via examples; any non-empty string is accepted.

relPath.description: A path relative to the policy folder. Must not be absolute or escape the folder.

vec3.description: A 3-vector [x, y, z] in world-space metres.

id.description: Stable, URL-safe clip id. Matches an entry in the motion library.

file.description: Path to the clip's playback data, relative to the policy folder. Format owned by issue wbc-mjlab-3ne.

durationSec.description: Optional clip length in seconds (drives the scrubber range).
